content: {"rule": "K-G4", "applies": "yes", "applies_why": "The judge counts cited verses (Matthew 1:18, 25, Luke 1:34) as unanswered witnesses against the challenger's link without quoting any earlier-round sentence that pressed them or naming any round.", "verdict": "BREACH", "quote": "Matthew 1:18 'before they came together, she was found with child of the Holy Ghost' and Matthew 1:25 'knew her not till she had brought forth her firstborn son' contradict C3's claim of espousal union", "rule_words": "A verse on a side's 'cited in' line counts as an unanswered witness only when the judge quotes the sentence of the earlier round that pressed it against that link or a listed premise and names that round; a verse cited there but not pressed against the link does not count.", "room": "'quotes the sentence of the earlier round that pressed it... and names that round': whether the judge may count verses without citing the pressing round at all, versus requiring both the quoted sentence and round label; the judge names no round and quotes no earlier sentence.", "why": "The judge treats the cited verses as unanswered witnesses breaking the link but names no earlier round and quotes no earlier-round sentence that pressed them, which K-G4 requires before such verses count."}
